subject: Intro + exec presence for Dockline demo (CIO/VP attendance)
messages:
From: Marta Silva <marta@dockline.co>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Dockline x Redwood — exec intro & demo?

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for the quick sync last week. We’re excited to see Redwood in action and would like to schedule a demo that includes our CTO Tom Brennan and a VP-level stakeholder (likely our VP of Product). The ask: a 40–50 minute demo + 20-minute CIO/VP pre-brief (informal) to align on architecture and success criteria.

Two windows that work on our side:
- Wednesday, June 29 — 2:00pm PT (good for Tom)
- Thursday, June 30 — 5:30pm PT (evening option for APAC presence)

Would one of those work for your exec(s)? We’re happy to take a short pre-demo "coffee window" — 20 minutes to cover constraints (data residency, SSO/KM integrations) before the main demo.

If you prefer, propose a couple of alternatives and I’ll route to Tom. Also: can you send a draft agenda so we can prep internal questions?

Best,
Marta Silva
Director of Engineering
Dockline

Attachments: none
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Silva <marta@dockline.co>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 10:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dockline x Redwood — exec intro & demo?

Hi Marta — great to hear from you. Thanks for the windows. We can absolutely support CIO/VP attendance and the pre-brief idea is smart. Quick notes and options from our side: 

- Option A (preferred): Tue, June 29, 2027 — 2:00pm PT (40m demo + 20m pre-brief at 1:30pm PT)
- Option B: Thu, July 1, 2027 — 9:00am PT (alternate morning for APAC overlap)

We’ll plan to have one of our engineering leads and a product exec on the call. If Tom prefers to keep the pre-brief very short, we can do a 15-minute focused rundown.

I’ve attached a draft agenda and the current proposal so you can share with Tom and the VP. Please confirm which option works and whether you want the pre-brief to be recorded (some customers prefer not to record the exec-only segment).

Next steps: once you confirm, Ben will coordinate the calendar invites and Jasmine will pull the SSO/KMS prep checklist to make sure we cover those items.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Director, Solutions 
Redwood Inference

Attachments: agenda_draft.docx, proposal_v2.pdf
From: Tom Brennan <tom.b@dockline.co>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Marta Silva <marta@dockline.co>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 12:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dockline x Redwood — exec intro & demo?

Evelyn / Marta — thanks. I’ll be traveling the week of the 29th and 30th (in EMEA) so the first two options are tight for me. Can we move the main demo to Friday, July 2 at 11:00am ET (8:00am PT)? I can do a short 20-minute pre-brief at 10:30am ET that day.

Quick clarification: during the pre-brief I’d like to cover our SSO provider (Okta), expected throughput for peak windows, and any support for on-prem/private deployments — we’ll want the right folks in the room for that.

If July 2 doesn't work, Ben — is there a senior product/architecture lead who can attend in my place at the June 29 slot?

Thanks,
Tom Brennan
CIO, Dockline

On Mon, Jun 21, 2027 at 10:00 AM Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Marta — great to hear from you. Thanks for the windows. We can absolutely support CIO/VP attendance...
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Brennan <tom.b@dockline.co>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Marta Silva <marta@dockline.co>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 13:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dockline x Redwood — exec intro & demo?

Tom — thanks for flagging travel. I can take the June 29 slot as senior technical cover if that helps — happy to represent Redwood product/arch. That would allow you to see the recording and we can do a 20-minute follow-up briefing with you on July 2 at 11:00am ET to answer any outstanding architecture questions.

If you prefer to keep this live for Tom, July 2 at 11:00am ET works for us; Evelyn/Jasmine and I will hold that time. I’ll: 
- Draft the calendar invites now (sending to all)
- Add a 20-minute pre-brief at 10:30am ET (exec-only)
- Link the HubSpot deal and the agenda in the event notes

Marta — expect invites from me in the next 30 minutes. Also, we’ll mark the exec pre-brief as "no recording" unless you confirm otherwise.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Director, Product Partnerships
Redwood Inference
